name: Artikolo – AI Content Writer & Blog Post Generator
author: penguinsparklyed32df7e26

sections.description:
Artikolo is an AI content writer, AI content generator, and blog post generator built for WordPress. Turn any topic or keyword into a complete, SEO-optimized blog post with one click. No more staring at blank pages – just enter your idea and let the AI write for you.

All-in-One AI Writing Tool for WordPress

Artikolo is the AI writing tool that lives inside your WordPress dashboard. Unlike standalone AI writing assistants, everything happens where you work — generate an article, review it, and publish without leaving your site. No copy-pasting from ChatGPT, no reformatting, no wasted time. It’s the AI writing assistant built specifically for WordPress content creators.

SEO Automation (Coming Soon)

Our SEO Automation feature will bring keyword research, SEO audits, rank tracking, schema markup, and automated content clusters directly into your WordPress dashboard. Visit wordpressaiplugin.com to join the waitlist.

Key Features

AI Article Generator
Enter a topic, keyword, or blog post idea and get a complete article in seconds. The AI writes structured, readable content with proper headings, paragraphs, and formatting ready for WordPress.

Content Rewriter from URL
Paste any URL and the AI will analyze it and create fresh, original content on the same topic. Great for creating alternative takes on competitor content or updating old posts.

SEO-Optimized Output
Every article is structured with proper H2/H3 heading hierarchy for search engines. Works seamlessly with Yoast SEO, Rank Math, and All in One SEO to set focus keywords and meta descriptions.

One-Click Auto-Publish
Generate and publish directly to WordPress as a draft or live post. Skip the copy-paste workflow – everything happens inside your WordPress admin.

Works with Gutenberg & Classic Editor
Generated content is clean HTML that works perfectly with both the block editor and classic editor. Compatible with Elementor, Divi, and other page builders.

Flexible Subscription Plans
Choose from Starter, Pro, or Business plans with monthly article allowances. Plans include multilingual support, SEO-optimized output, and direct WordPress publishing. Track your usage from the plugin dashboard.

Real-Time Generation Progress
Watch your content being written with live progress updates. See exactly what’s happening as the AI generates your article.

Who Is This For?

  • Bloggers – Keep your blog updated with fresh posts without spending hours writing
  • Content Marketers – Scale your content strategy and hit publishing deadlines
  • SEO Agencies – Generate keyword-targeted blog posts for client sites
  • E-commerce Sites – Write product descriptions, category pages, and blog content
  • Affiliate Marketers – Create product reviews, comparison articles, and buying guides
  • Niche Site Builders – Populate new sites with quality content fast
  • Local Businesses – Build authority with regular blog posts about your industry

Benefits

  • Write Blog Posts in Minutes – Generate a complete article faster than you could write an outline
  • Automated Content Creation – Scale your publishing with automated content creation that handles writing, formatting, and SEO in one step
  • Unique Content Every Time – Each article is created fresh for your specific topic and keywords
  • SEO-Ready Structure – Proper heading hierarchy, keyword placement, and meta descriptions
  • 24/7 Content Generation – Create articles whenever inspiration strikes or deadlines loom

How It Works

  1. Install & Connect – Install the plugin and connect with your API key
  2. Enter Your Topic – Type a topic, keyword, or sentence
  3. Choose Options – Select category, post status, and preferences
  4. Generate – Click the button and the AI creates your content
  5. Review & Publish – Edit if needed and publish to your site

Why Choose Artikolo Over ChatGPT?

A Purpose-Built AI Writing Assistant
ChatGPT is a general-purpose tool. Artikolo is a dedicated AI writing assistant built specifically for WordPress blogging – proper heading structure, SEO formatting, and direct publishing are built in.

No Copy-Paste Workflow
With ChatGPT, you generate content in one tab, then copy it, paste it into WordPress, fix the formatting, add headings… Artikolo does all of this automatically.

Works With Your WordPress SEO Plugin
Artikolo integrates with every major WordPress SEO plugin — Yoast, Rank Math, and AIOSEO — to automatically set focus keywords and meta descriptions. ChatGPT can’t do that.

Content Stays Yours
We don’t store your generated content or use it for AI training. Your blog posts and topics are private.

Dedicated Support
Get help from people who understand WordPress content creation, not generic AI support.

SEO Plugin Compatibility

Artikolo integrates with the top WordPress SEO plugins:

  • Yoast SEO – Automatically sets focus keyphrase and meta description
  • Rank Math SEO – Full compatibility including focus keywords and SEO score optimization
  • All in One SEO (AIOSEO) – Sets meta titles, descriptions, and focus keywords
  • Gutenberg Block Editor – Clean HTML output formatted for WordPress blocks
  • Classic Editor – Works perfectly with TinyMCE and the classic editing experience
  • Page Builders – Compatible with Elementor, Divi, Beaver Builder, and others

Privacy Policy

Artikolo connects to external servers at wordpressaiplugin.com to provide AI content generation services. Here’s what happens with your data:

Data We Collect:
* API key for authentication (stored in your WordPress database)
* Topic/keyword information sent for content generation
* Basic usage statistics to improve service

Data We Don’t Collect:
* Personal information from your users
* Your website visitor data
* Your login credentials

Data Processing:
* Content is generated on our secure servers and transmitted to your WordPress site
* We do not store generated content after delivery
* We do not use your prompts or content to train our AI models
* All data transmission is encrypted via HTTPS

Your Rights:
* You can delete your account and all associated data at any time
* You can export your data upon request
* You can opt out of usage statistics

For complete details, please read our full Privacy Policy and Terms of Service.
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation (Recommended)

  1. Log in to your WordPress admin dashboard
  2. Navigate to Plugins -> Add New
  3. Search for “Artikolo”
  4. Click Install Now then Activate
  5. Go to Artikolo in your admin menu
  6. Enter your API key to connect

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file from WordPress.org
  2. Log in to your WordPress admin dashboard
  3. Navigate to Plugins -> Add New -> Upload Plugin
  4. Choose the downloaded ZIP file and click Install Now
  5. Click Activate Plugin
  6. Go to Artikolo in your admin menu to configure

Getting Your API Key

  1. Visit wordpressaiplugin.com and create a free account
  2. Log in to your account dashboard
  3. Copy your API key from the settings page
  4. Paste it into the plugin settings in WordPress
  5. Click Test Connection to verify
  6. Start generating content!
sections.faq:
Is the content original?

Yes. Each piece of content is generated fresh by our AI for your specific request. The AI creates new content each time.

Do I need an account to use this plugin?

Yes, you need a free or paid account at wordpressaiplugin.com to access the content generation service. The plugin handles all communication with our servers securely.

What languages does the AI support?

Artikolo supports content generation in 9 languages: English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Dutch, Polish, and Japanese. Multilingual content generation is available on Pro and Business plans.

Can I edit the content after generation?

Absolutely! Content is generated as a draft by default, giving you complete control to edit, revise, and perfect it before publishing.

Is this plugin GDPR compliant?

Yes, we take privacy seriously. We don’t store your content after generation and comply with GDPR requirements. Your data is processed securely.

How many articles can I generate per month?

This depends on your plan. Starter includes 4 articles per month, Pro gives you 15, and Business provides 40. All plans include a free trial so you can try the service before committing.

Does the AI write about any topic?

The AI can write about most general topics including business, technology, health & wellness, lifestyle, travel, food, finance, and more. Some topics may have limitations for safety reasons.

What about AI-generated content and search engines?

Search engines focus on content quality, not how it’s produced. Our AI creates well-structured, informative content. We recommend reviewing and personalizing content before publishing.

What makes this different from ChatGPT?

Artikolo is purpose-built for WordPress content creation. It’s optimized for generating blog articles with proper formatting, SEO structure, and direct WordPress integration. No copy-pasting or reformatting needed.

Does this use ChatGPT / GPT-4 / OpenAI?

Artikolo uses advanced AI models to generate content. The AI is optimized specifically for blog writing and SEO content, producing better results for WordPress than general-purpose chatbots.

Can I generate bulk content or multiple articles?

Currently, Artikolo focuses on one article at a time to ensure quality. Bulk generation features are on our roadmap. You can generate as many individual articles as your credits allow.

Can I use this for client work?

Yes! Many agencies use Artikolo to scale content production. The content you generate is yours to use however you like, including for commercial purposes.

What if I’m not satisfied with the generated content?

You can regenerate content on any topic until you’re satisfied. We recommend being specific with your prompts for best results. Our support team is here to help if you have issues.

Does it work with page builders?

The generated content is standard HTML that works with any page builder or theme. Use it with Elementor, Divi, Beaver Builder, or any other WordPress page builder.

What is SEO Automation and when will it be available?

SEO Automation is our upcoming feature that will automate content cluster creation – from keyword research to writing interlinked articles to publishing. It’s currently in development. Sign up at wordpressaiplugin.com to join the waitlist.

What subscription plans are available?

Artikolo offers three plans: Starter (4 articles/month), Pro (15 articles/month with multilingual support), and Business (40 articles/month with premium AI editing). All plans are available in GBP, USD, and EUR with a free trial included.

Is Artikolo an AI writing tool or just a ChatGPT wrapper?

Artikolo is a standalone AI writing tool, not a ChatGPT wrapper. While it uses advanced AI models, the entire content pipeline is custom-built for WordPress — from SEO-optimized heading structures and keyword placement to direct publishing and SEO plugin integration. A generic chatbot can’t format content for Gutenberg, set Yoast focus keywords, or publish to your site. Artikolo handles all of that automatically.

Does Artikolo include keyword research and SEO audit tools?

Keyword research tool and SEO audit features are coming soon as part of our SEO Automation module. The planned toolkit includes a keyword research tool to discover content opportunities, an SEO audit tool to analyse your existing content, rank tracking to monitor keyword positions, and schema markup generation. Today, the plugin already generates SEO-optimized articles with proper heading hierarchy and integrates with Yoast, Rank Math, and AIOSEO for focus keywords and meta descriptions.

How does this compare to other WordPress SEO plugins?

Artikolo is not a traditional WordPress SEO plugin like Yoast or Rank Math — it works alongside them. While a WordPress SEO plugin helps you optimise content you’ve already written, Artikolo generates the content itself, already structured for SEO. It then integrates with your existing WordPress SEO plugin to set focus keywords and meta descriptions automatically. Think of it as the content creation layer that feeds into your SEO workflow.
